name: Texas walnut
desc: Texas walnut (Juglans microcarpa): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 5 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Juglans microcarpa, known also as the little walnut, Texas walnut, Texas black walnut or little black walnut, is a large shrub or small tree (10–30 ft tall) which grows wild along streams and ravines…
